_note: Machine-readable twin of _base/presentation-scaffold.md. Loaded by scripts/present.py and by the deep unit test gate. Keys are stable identifiers; edit wording freely, never rename keys.

tier1.name: Executive quick-glance card
tier1.source: summary.json emitted at the end of every run that writes a deliverable
tier1.rule: Every number is copied from the Tier 2 deliverable; unmeasured values render as could not verify.

tier2.name: Comprehensive client deliverable
tier2.source: unified 19-tab report via render_report.py, or the skill's own dated file under its registered route
tier2.rule: Unchanged by the presentation layer. Never truncated or replaced by the card.

host_ladder.renders: HTML fragment on host CSS variables, Tabler outline icons, transparent outer background, 680px, dark-mode safe
single self-contained HTML, inline CSS and SVG, zero external requests, reflows to 360px
workflow, pipeline, decision tree, mindmap only; a host that does not render fenced mermaid shows raw code, so use ascii there
pure ASCII tree diagram of score, key risk, actions or steps, dimensions, hand-off and next steps inside a fenced text block
rich Markdown with ASCII bars [#####-----], text pills, GitHub alert blocks

auto_detection.fallback_rule: on render failure drop exactly one rung and retry

quick_fact.md_shape: > [!TIP] answer lines, then a bullet list

structure: numbered steps with circled digits in Markdown
howto.md_shape: ordered list, each item: title, then Do and Expect lines

triggers_th: เปรียบเทียบ
เลือกอันไหน

troubleshoot.md_shape: > [!CAUTION] Root cause, then ordered list of fixes

audit.md_shape: score line, glyph bars, tables, > [!WARNING] key risk, numbered actions, hand-off line

deployable.md_shape: fenced code per file with language, path line under each

structure: each an exact slash command or message
next_steps.md_shape: Next steps heading with a short list of commands

extensions.diff: Before versus after with score delta

glyph_policy.html_and_pdf_rule: inline SVG icons only, no glyphs, no emoji

bar.why: block-shade glyphs fall back to a different font in most Markdown previews and Windows consoles (cp874) and overflow the line; ASCII renders identically everywhere
